subject: maths

items.q: What do the angles in a triangle add up to?
items.why: Triangle angles sum to 180°; quadrilaterals sum to 360°.

items.q: What happens to angles when you enlarge a shape?
items.correct: They stay the same — only side lengths change.
items.misconception: They get bigger with the shape.
items.why: Enlargement produces similar shapes: equal angles, scaled sides.

items.q: Do shapes with the same perimeter have the same area?
items.correct: No — equal perimeters can give very different areas.
items.random_wrong: Area is measured in the same units as length.
items.why: For example a long thin rectangle and a square can share a perimeter but differ hugely in area.
